newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek sees '97 earnings up for new group.
newsitem.headline: Partek sees '97 earnings up for new group.

text.p: Finnish building materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab said on Friday it expected 1997 earnings for the new group improve on the two companies' combined earnings last year.
"The Partek group's earnings are expected to improve this year compared to the combined results of Partek and Sisu last year," Partek said in a statement with its January-April results.
The group was formed through its merger earlier this year with engineering group Sisu Oy.

It said the January-April trend supported its earlier views that only a small portion of the result would come from the January-April period due to seasonal fluctuation and that Sisu would have good chances to improve its full-year result.
Partek's 1996 profit after financial items was 226 million markka and Sisu's was 112 million.

Partek reported January-April profit after financial items surging to 50.8 million markka from 9.2 million in the year-ago period, but Sisu's profit fell to 0.6 million markka from 39.5 million in January-April 1996.
